items.title: China Probes DeepSeek and Moonshot Over Alleged Data Leaks to Anthropic's Claude
items.summary: China's internet regulator is investigating DeepSeek and Moonshot AI after Anthropic accused both of secretly routing millions of user exchanges through Claude to train their own models.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls Through the $86,000 ETF Cost Basis as the Whole Market Turns Lower
items.summary: Total crypto market value fell 2.27% to $2.96 trillion.

items.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang found dead at 37
items.summary: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

items.title: Kalshi says it is not being investigated by the CFTC over trading activity
items.summary: The prediction market says unusual patterns in its ether perpetual market are the result of liquidity incentives.
